product.title: Lg Oled Evo Ai C Series 4k Smart Tv
product.description: Experience the pinnacle of home entertainment with the LG OLED evo AI C5 4K Smart TV. This television boasts a 65-inch display with Brightness Booster technology for exceptionally luminous detail and a Bright Room Ready certification, ensuring optimal performance in any lighting condition. Powered by the Alpha 9 AI Processor Gen8, it delivers smooth, crisp picture and sound with AI Picture Pro and AI Super Upscaling. Enjoy perfect blacks and vibrant colors thanks to over 8.3 million self-lit OLED pixels. For cinephiles, Dolby Vision®, Dolby Atmos®, and FILMMAKER MODE™ bring the magic of cinema home. Gamers will appreciate the 144Hz refresh rate, NVIDIA G-Sync, AMD FreeSync Premium, and a 0.1ms response time. LG's intuitive webOS platform provides access to a universe of entertainment, including streaming apps and over 350 free LG Channels, with the added benefit of future software updates through the webOS Re:New Program. Seamlessly connect and share content with Apple AirPlay 2 and Google Cast, and control your smart home ecosystem with built-in support for ThinQ, Google Assistant, Amazon Alexa, Matter, and Apple HomeKit.
